newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CBANK SETS 4-WK T-BILL AUCTION WED AT 14.5 PCT. [CORRECTED 11:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: CZECH CBANK SETS 4-WK T-BILL AUCTION WED AT 14.5 PCT. [CORRECTED 11:30 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline to read 14.5 pct instead of 16 pct)

The Czech central bank on Tuesday announced an auction offering five billion crowns in four-week finance ministry treasury bills on Wednesday, with the maximum gross yield on bids limited to 14.5 percent.
The gross yield corresponds to a minimum bid of 988,848 crowns for the bills with a nominal value of one million crowns.
In the previous auction of four-week T-bills on July 23, the gross yield was 15.8 percent.
The central bank added that the ministry was taking a five billion crown tranche of the bills into its own portfolio.
